desc: Implement sweep-middle-index solution with left/right frequency maps and distinct-pair counts.
Count cases where at least two side elements equal the middle value.
Count exactly-one-side-middle-value cases with three distinct non-middle values using opposite-side distinct zero-middle-value pairs excluding the non-middle value.
Validate sample tests and edge cases, including all-equal, all-distinct, small n, duplicates across sides, and modulo behavior.
